Official Academy Policy Document

Rules and Regulations

Our code of honor and operational standards for all players and parents.

Core Commitment

"A Better Dream for a Better Life"

Every parent and player signs this agreement upon enrollment to ensure an elite, distraction-free environment.

1. Enrollment & Background Disclosure

Parents must fully disclose the trainee's medical background, behavioral history, and school status upon enrollment. Full transparency regarding past behavioral records, school performance, and any chronic medical conditions ensures our coaching staff can nurture each trainee safely and effectively.

2. Mandatory Academic Standards

Players are expected to excel in school alongside football. We monitor term report cards strictly:

Ages 6 – 11 (U10 Category)

Must Rank 1st – 5th in Class

Foundational years where core reading, arithmetic, and study discipline are cemented.

Term report cards audited
Ages 11 – 13 (U13 Category)

Must Rank 1st – 10th in Class

Transition to middle school requires active time-management between homework and football.

Term report cards audited
Ages 14 – 16 (U15 & 17 Categories)

Must Rank 1st – 20th in Class

National examination preparation and competitive tournament balance.

Term report cards audited
🎯 Overall average school result expectation: up to 90%

3. Discipline — Strictly Forbidden

To protect player focus and mental clarity, the following activities are strictly prohibited for enrolled trainees:

Mobile phone games

Addictive mobile gaming damages eyesight, concentration, and sleep cycles.

Video games & Arcade parlors

Commercial gaming parlors and arcade houses promote distraction and peer delinquency.

PlayStation / Gaming consoles

PlayStation and console addictions waste vital study and rest hours.

Pool / Foosball gaming spots

Commercial pool tables and foosball spots foster gambling environments.

Playing unauthorized football matches outside the academy

Unsupervised street football risks severe injury and ruins structured athletic development.

⚠️ Violations will result in parental conferences, temporary suspension, or expulsion from the academy.
